how: Set the groups (code <cluster>_<slug>, label, description, kind: group, qualifier or not_this_sense; anchor optional). Give every head pair a group and a reason; tail pairs may be left for the Tail step. two_sense 1 where the pair carries two senses. An inherited pair keeps its subgroup unless its surface does not fit it: then change the group and start the reason with 'correction:'. Then run -Step Apply with this file.

groups.label: Desire, craving, longing
groups.description: wanting what is not yet had: desire, craving, longing, coveting, lust

groups.label: Delight, pleasure, gladness
groups.description: taking pleasure in what is had or met: delight, pleasure, gladness

groups.label: Will, wish, choosing, willingness
groups.description: the act of willing: will, wish, want, choose, be willing, purpose

groups.label: Favour, acceptance, approval
groups.description: being acceptable to another, or judging a thing good: favour, acceptance, 'it seemed good to'

groups.label: Jealousy, zeal, envy
groups.description: zeal and jealousy, for or against another: jealousy, zeal, envy

groups.label: Thirst, hunger
groups.description: thirst and hunger, of the body and of the soul

groups.label: Precious, costly, valued
groups.description: what is held dear or of great worth: precious, costly, treasures, honour

groups.label: Beauty
groups.description: what is pleasing to the eye: beautiful, attractive, handsome, lovely

groups.label: Striving after
groups.description: the futile pursuit of 'striving after wind' (H7469)

groups.label: Good, better, well (a quality of something)
groups.description: tov and its kin used as a quality of what it qualifies; a judging use is the characteristic and is settled per verse (E4, two-sense)

groups.label: Not the cluster's sense
groups.description: renderings whose sense is not desire: distance, a matter, destruction, a party's name
